SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS: 1. BRIEF OF REQUIREMENT: The requirement pertains to Bhilai Steel Plant Mines in Chhattisgarh located at Rajh ara, Rowghat, Nandini Limestone Mines &Hirri Dolomite Mines. Non- Electric Initiatio n systems (NONEL), comprising of Down-the-Hole delay detonators (DTH) & Surface Trunk Lines delay detonators (STL/TLD), Cord Relay (CR)& Ordinary Detonators (OD) are the different products and shall be procured on Overall L-1 Basis of LCNITC Valu e. BSP may place a quantity Purchase Order or SODC order for value based contract . The tender quantity of individual item is indicative quantity and may change based on the actual production requirement of individual item at different BSP Mines within the SODC contract value. Tenderer should provide their product catalogues along with their techno-commerci al offer. 2. PRODUCT SUPPLY: The products offered by the Tenderer for all categories should conform to the specifications as mentioned in the respective item code. Source of supply of the res pective items (Magazines/Works) to be indicated in the techno commercial bid. The Ordinary Detonators (OD) must be supplied in boxes containing a size code of 1 000 units per box as per PESO norms. However, the bidders can source Ordinary Detonators (OD) with size code of 1000 u nits per box from any vendors having valid license from PESO (However source has to be confirmed by the bidders in their bid document) and the supplier must raise th eir own invoice for such delivery 3. LICENSE: The tenderers shall have to submit self-attested copy of the valid explosive license f rom the Controller of Explosives for the manufacture of Detonators, NONEL(Shock T ube-DTH &STL/TLD) and Cord Relays. It will be the responsibility of the successful tenderer to obtain valid permission / lice nse from the Chief Controller of Explosives, Government of India or any other statut ory body as may be required for manufacture, Any DGMS/ Statutory permission, if n ecessary, will be obtained by the successful tenderer. No supply should be effected without having valid permission from DGMS / License from CCOE / License from PES O for the product even if there is an allocation for supply of the product for a Mine. 4. ORDER DISTRIBUTION :

a. The tenderer shall quote for the full tendered quantity indicated in the tender doc ument. However, SAIL reserves the right to split the Market quantity to more than o ne tenderer. The tenderer shall be ranked L-1, L-2, etc. on the basis of overall quote d value i.e. lowest value shall be ranked as L-1 and so on. b. The L-1 tenderer will be allocated the maximum value for the tendered quantity. The total LCNITC value shall be the criteria for order distribution not the it em wise quantity/ total quantity. c. Distribution of the balance quantity will be done among the eligible tenderers wh o match the price of Market L-1 vendor. The volume of order to be distributed to oth er tenderers who match the price of Market L-1, will be based on their initial ranking on closure of reverse auction / opening of price bids (submitted online) and based o n maximum number of supplier(s) for order distribution. d. The distribution of quantities shall be in the descending order as per the quoted Market-wise price ranking of tenderers i.e. Market-wise L-1 tenderer shall get the hi ghest share and the last ranked tenderers within which the total order is to be distri buted, will get the smallest share. e. Diversion of supplies: In case of necessity, arising out of non supply/application of materials as per the order schedule and poor performance by any supplier, it shall be the option for Bhilai Steel Plant,SAIL to offload / divert part o r full order quantity from the defaulted supplier to other supplier against the same t ender and acceptance from the party on whom it is getting diverted. If the party on whom it is getting diverted does not agree, Risk Purchase action will be taken again st the L-1 party. In case of diversion of quantity a prior amendment to the PO will be issued. 5. INSPECTION: SAIL reserves the right to inspect the materials at destination. Materials not conforming to the specifications shall not be used and sha ll lie rejected at the risk and cost of seller and the seller shall be informed of such rej ection for action as per standard practice of respective BSP mines. 6. TESTINGMODALITIES: Supplier will indicate the performance parameters o f the individual products. If required, the parameters like VOD & tensile strength sha ll be tested by BSP at premises of respective Mine by the manufacturer at premises of BSP Mine with their own equipment in presence of representatives of Head of Min es. In case equipments are available at mines testing can be made by the mines in the presence of representatives of the manufacturer. If required, Random testing shall be done at the mines site by CIMFR / CMPDIL/ any

other authorized agency. Mines have the right to select any product/products from any consignment supplied to the Mines at random, seal it jointly in the presence of t he supplier’s authorized representative. However, in case of rejection the cost of tes ting shall be recovered from the supplier. 7. DELIVERY: FOR Deliveries will be made to the SAIL/BSP Mines strictly on the basis of bac k up purchase orders issued by BSP Mines. No delivery shall be made without such b ack up orders & Form RE 11/Supply order. The delivery schedule in RE11 will be given by respective Mines at least 7 days in advance. All dispatches will be made b y road and up to the site of the Mines following statutory requirements. The date of receipt of consignment at the stores of SAIL/BSP mines will be considere d as date of delivery. Delivery schedule would be provided in the back-up purchase orders to be issued by respective plant/ unit/ mines, which the supplier should adher e to. Delivery period of the LOA/PO shall be for around 12 months, tentatively from 15th July ’2026 to 14th July 2027 (may vary as per finalization of tender). BSP w ithin the contract period have the option of extending the contract by 3 ad ditional months beyond the period of contract. Deliveries shall be made strictly as per schedule issued by mines as per Form RE 11 /Supply order. Each supply should be accompanied with copies of form RE 11/Supply order along with duly filled in form RE 12. Supply shall be strictly as per Explosive ru les. Suppliers shall put up compliance against each RE 11/Supply order issued by mines Suppliers should timely report to the local police station and to concerned mines reg arding any untoward incident during transit and follow Explosive Rules 2008 and lat est amendments thereof with regard to supply and movement of explosives and any other applicable rules issued by Government. However, delivery up to the mines ma gazine, including all expenses during transit, will be the sole responsibility of the su pplier. 8. INSURANCE: Transit Insurance up to the SAIL/BSP Mines site will be eff ected by the supplier and the relevant costs will be borne by the supplier a nd will not be to the account of SAIL/BSP Mines . 9. TRANSPORTATION CHARGES : The delivery shall be made FOR BSP Mines Store/Magazine basis as per location given in RE-11 raised by BSP Mines. Tenderer may quote freight charges on “PAID” basis (included in quoted price for material) or “TO BE BILLED” basis.

10. PACKING / MARKING & DESPATCHES: All dispatches are to be made by road and should be supplied securely packed and marked in accordance with the Explosives Rules 2008. Each consignment should be invoiced, quoting referenc e number & date of the Order and Amendments, if any, and to be accompanied by t he manufacturer’s Test Certificate and date of production of the manufacture. This manufacturer’s Test Certificate should also be submitted with the bill along with oth er necessary statutory documents. 11. RESCINDING OF CONTRACT : SAIL reserves the right to suspend/ canc el/ short close the order/ reduce the order quantity, if the supplier’s performanc e is found unsatisfactory with respect to quality and adherence to delivery sched ule. The supplier will not be entitled to any loss and damage because and owing to s uch suspension/ cancellation/ short closure and SAIL mines shall not be liable for the same. SAIL reserves the right to decrease / cancel the Order at any point of time an d without assigning any reason whatsoever in the matter without any liability to co mpensate for any losses suffered by the supplier. SAIL/BSP Mines are also not b ound to lift the entire quantity of the Order. 12. VARIATION IN ORDER QUANTITIES: SAIL/BSP reserves the right to alter t he total ordered quantity by +/- 25%, before the completion of the contract period. For this purpose, an amendment to Purchase order would be issued by SAIL/BSP. 13. SPECIAL TECHNICAL SERVICES: As and when required by SAIL mines, the supplier shall provide technical services to improve blasting efficiencies, free of cost . 14. FAILURE &TERMINATION: Should the Supplier fail to deliver the stores or any consignment thereof, within the period prescribed for such delivery, the Purchaser shall be entitled at his option, to t he following: a) Liquidated Damages : In event of supply not being effected within the contractual delivery schedule as indicated in RE-11/Supply order liquidated damages @ 0.5%, not by way of penalty, of the value of the materials without taxes, duties & freight, per week of delay or pa rt thereof, subject to maximum of 10%of total contract/PO value, is recoverable fro m the supplier without prejudice to the rights of Purchaser to procure the balance m aterial at the risk and cost of the supplier. The payment or deduction of such damag

es shall not relieve the Supplier from the contractual obligations to complete the su pply or balance portion thereof in time as stipulated in the Contract. The applicable GST on Liquidated Damages shall also be recovered. b) Risk Purchase: If the Supplier fails to deliver the stores either in full or in part, within the prescribed delivery period as mentioned in the RE-11/supply order, the Purchaser shall be entitl ed at his option to take alternate procurement action, at the risk & cost of the suppli er for the unsupplied portion of the goods / items for which delivery has expired with out canceling the contract in respect of the stores not yet due for delivery, or to can cel the contract based on progress of work, including stores not due for delivery, an d, if thought fit/necessary, to purchase the stores at the risk and cost of the Supplier . The price differential in case of higher cost to SAIL, if any, shall have to be borne b y the defaulting supplier. Moreover, the defaulting supplier shall have no claim over the quantity, which they failed to supply. 15. GUARANTEE: The explosives supplied shall be guaranteed for the shelf life period from the date of supply against defective quality and performance. 16. TERMS OF PAYMENTS : 100% payment will be made on receipt & acceptance of materials (GARN) and again st clear bills submitted with complete documents (as enumerated below) to the Fina nce Department BSP.
